title.zh-CN: 发热、腹股沟红肿 · 8岁男孩
title.en: Fever and a swollen groin · 8-year-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 8岁男孩发热5天，右侧腹股沟红肿疼痛，外院抗感染治疗无效，收住儿科病房。
summary.en: An 8-year-old boy is admitted to the children's ward after five days of fever and a painful, swollen right groin that did not settle with treatment elsewhere.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别进行性软组织脓肿伴全身感染的患儿抗革兰阳性菌治疗失败，并在淡水或泥土接触后、培养回报前扩大经验性覆盖至革兰阴性及环境菌（碳青霉烯类）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise failure of anti-Gram-positive therapy in a child with progressive soft-tissue abscesses and systemic infection, and broaden empirical cover to Gram-negative and environmental organisms (a carbapenem) after freshwater or soil exposure, before the cultures return.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据Phoenix 2024标准，用灌注、乳酸（换算为mmol/L）、凝血和神经系统表现识别脓毒性休克，并说出SSC 2026首小时的处置要点。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify septic shock with the Phoenix 2024 criteria from perfusion, lactate (converted to mmol/L), coagulation and neurological findings, and state the SSC 2026 first-hour priorities.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把感染源控制与按药敏的目标治疗结合起来，并说明多发小脓肿为何需要长疗程。
learningOutcomes.en: Combine source control with susceptibility-guided definitive therapy, and justify a long course for multiple small abscesses.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释紫色色杆菌侵袭性感染为何需要评估吞噬细胞功能（DHR/NBT）和G6PD，并指出本例记录缺少哪些检查。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why invasive Chromobacterium violaceum infection calls for phagocyte-function (DHR/NBT) and G6PD testing, and name what this record lacks.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读病例结局时，区分放弃治疗后的死亡与治疗无效的死亡。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish death after withdrawal of care from death despite treatment when appraising a reported outcome.

The report's CT figure (figure 1) and the source PDF that reprints it show patient identifiers and are withheld for privacy, with the CT findings kept as text; figure 2 (cultured colonies) keeps its original annotations. Discrepancies within the source (two wordings of when he swam; NK cells listed with the blood count) are labelled, not resolved.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 发热5天伴右腹股沟红肿
chiefComplaint.en: Five days of fever with a red, swollen right groin

triageNote.zh-CN: 8岁男孩，由家长陪同。发热5天，右侧腹股沟红肿、有包块；外院用过两种抗菌药物仍高热（最高40 ℃）、畏寒明显，现在疼得不能走路。急诊收入儿科病房。
triageNote.en: 8-year-old boy with his parent. Five days of fever and a red, swollen lump in the right groin; still febrile (up to 40 °C) with marked chills despite two antibiotics at another hospital, and now too sore to walk. Admitted from the emergency department to the children's ward.

personality.zh-CN: 8岁男孩，被几天的高烧和疼痛折腾得没精神，话很少；直接问他时会简短回答，一碰右腿就躲、会喊疼。
personality.en: An 8-year-old boy worn out by days of fever and pain; he says little, answers simple direct questions briefly, and flinches and cries out when his right leg is touched.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子只说一两句简单的话；家长用口语讲经过，不用医学术语，药名照外院资料上的写法说。
speechStyle.en: The boy manages a few simple words; his parent tells the story in everyday language, without medical terms, and reads the drug names as they appear on the other hospital's papers.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家长）医生，孩子烧了5天了，右边大腿根肿起来一个包，越来越大，现在路都走不了。
openingLine.en: (Parent) Doctor, he's had a fever for five days and there's a lump at the top of his right leg that keeps getting bigger — now he can't walk.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个他的病历里没有记录，我说不上来。
fallbackUnknown.en: That isn't recorded in his case notes, so I can't really say.

concerns.zh-CN: 用了好几天药还是烧，到底是什么病？
concerns.en: He's had treatment for days and he's still burning up — what is it?
Will the lump on his leg need an operation?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 家长回答病史；孩子只回答直接问他的疼痛和走路的问题。第4天病情恶化以后，孩子不能说话，只由家长回答。家长焦虑、疲惫，但讲述连贯；病历里没有的细节（在哪里游泳、以前有没有反复感染）如实说不知道，不要编。
actingNotes.en: The parent gives the history; the boy answers only questions put to him about the pain and walking. From the deterioration on day 4 onwards the boy cannot speak and only the parent answers. The parent is anxious and tired but tells the story coherently, and says plainly when a detail is not in his notes (where he swam, whether he has had repeated infections) — never invent one.

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子从外院转来的家长：担心、睡得少，讲得出发病经过和外院用药；病历上没有写的事如实说不知道。说话直白，会一再追问孩子为什么一直不退烧。
persona.en: The parent who came with him from the other hospital: worried and short of sleep, able to tell the story and the earlier treatment, and honest that they don't know what his notes don't record. Speaks directly and keeps asking why the fever will not come down.

nonVerbalReason.zh-CN: 入院第4天起：抽搐、意识丧失，随后在PICU机械通气，不能说话；病史由家长回答。
nonVerbalReason.en: From hospital day 4: a seizure with loss of consciousness, then mechanical ventilation in the PICU — he cannot speak, and his parent answers.

description.zh-CN: 发热5天，由外院转来，急诊收入儿科病房。
description.en: After five days of fever he is referred from another hospital and admitted from the emergency department to the children's ward.

description.zh-CN: 原报告：入院后予静脉万古霉素（剂量未记录）及对症支持治疗。到第3天仍畏寒、持续高热、精神反应差，腹股沟包块进行性增大。本阶段的病程为原报告所载，与你入院时选择的方案无关。
description.en: In the report he received IV vancomycin (dose not recorded) and supportive care from admission. By day 3 he still had chills, a persistent high fever and poor responsiveness, and the groin lump was growing. The course in this phase is the report's, whatever regimen you chose on admission.

question.zh-CN: 孩子哪里不舒服？从什么时候开始的？
question.en: What's been wrong with him, and when did it start?

answer.zh-CN: 来医院前5天开始发烧的，刚开始38度5。同一天右边大腿根这儿红肿起来，能摸到一个黄豆大的包，一按就疼。
answer.en: The fever started five days before we came in — 38.5 at first. The same day the top of his right leg went red and swollen, and you could feel a lump about the size of a soybean that hurt when you pressed it.

answer.en: In those days at the local hospital the fever never went away — it went up to 40 and he was shivering with cold. The swelling got worse and the lump kept growing, until it hurt too much for him to walk.

question.zh-CN: 小朋友，哪里疼？能走路吗？

answer.en: Here… the top of my leg really hurts. It hurts when I move — I can't walk.

question.zh-CN: 来之前在当地医院用过什么药？效果怎么样？

answer.en: At the local hospital they gave him cefoperazone and another drug written on the papers as “yangpaiqin” (氧哌嗪). It didn't help — he kept running a fever.

source.en: Main text · present illness (cefoperazone and “氧哌嗪” elsewhere without improvement; doses and duration not recorded). “氧哌嗪” is kept as written; it may be the old Chinese name for piperacillin (氧哌嗪青霉素), which the report does not state (editor's inference, not a reported fact).

text.zh-CN: 两份腹股沟穿刺液和血培养均检出紫色色杆菌（Chromobacterium violaceum），血平板上为暗紫色菌落（原报告图2）。药敏：敏感——阿米卡星、氨曲南、环丙沙星、头孢吡肟、庆大霉素、亚胺培南、美罗培南、左氧氟沙星、复方磺胺甲噁唑（原文作“复方新诺明”）；中介——妥布霉素、替卡西林/克拉维酸、哌拉西林/他唑巴坦；耐药——头孢曲松、头孢他啶、哌拉西林。原文未给MIC和判读标准（讨论部分指出该菌尚无专门的药敏判读标准）。
text.en: Both groin-aspirate samples and the blood culture grew Chromobacterium violaceum, dark purple colonies on blood agar (the report's figure 2). Susceptible: amikacin, aztreonam, ciprofloxacin, cefepime, gentamicin, imipenem, meropenem, levofloxacin, co-trimoxazole. Intermediate: tobramycin, ticarcillin/clavulanate, piperacillin/tazobactam. Resistant: ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, piperacillin. MICs and interpretive criteria are not given (the discussion notes that no dedicated breakpoints exist for this organism).

source.zh-CN: 正文·入院第4天病程
source.en: Main text · course on hospital day 4

text.zh-CN: 抗菌治疗：根据药敏结果，同时考虑存在中枢神经系统症状，改用美罗培南（剂量未记录）；讨论部分指出此时已是病程第9天，“用药稍迟”。同时积极纠正休克、扩容、纠酸、纠正弥散性血管内凝血，输注血浆、静脉丙种球蛋白，行血液净化并加强支持治疗。病程：血小板进行性下降至7×10⁹/L，口鼻腔、消化道、皮肤黏膜及气道多处出血不止，休克反复出现，少尿，肺出血明显；呼吸机PEEP逐渐加至12 cmH₂O、PEEP上压力22 cmH₂O、FiO₂ 80%。补充凝血因子，输注血小板、凝血酶原复合物、冷沉淀等后血小板仍升高不明显，气管内不断有鲜红色血液涌出，SpO₂ 70%，尿量120 mL/24 h；继续血液净化及支持、对症治疗。入院第7天休克彻底纠正，出血好转，复查血小板升至35×10⁹/L。
text.en: Antimicrobials: guided by the susceptibilities, and because of his central nervous system signs, the team switched to meropenem (dose not recorded); the discussion notes this was illness day 9 — “a little late”. Alongside: active shock treatment, volume expansion, correction of acidosis and of disseminated intravascular coagulation, plasma, IV immunoglobulin, blood purification and intensive support. Course: platelets fell to 7×10⁹/L, with uncontrolled bleeding from the mouth and nose, gut, skin and mucosae and airway; recurrent shock; oliguria; marked pulmonary haemorrhage; PEEP was raised to 12 cmH₂O, pressure above PEEP to 22 cmH₂O and FiO₂ to 80%. Despite clotting factors, platelets, prothrombin complex concentrate and cryoprecipitate, platelets barely rose, fresh blood kept welling up from the trachea, SpO₂ was 70% and urine output 120 mL in 24 h; blood purification and supportive care continued. By hospital day 7 the shock had fully resolved, bleeding had improved and platelets were 35×10⁹/L.

text.en: On hospital day 8 his parents withdrew treatment for financial reasons; follow-up learned that he had died. The report's discussion says the infection had begun to respond and his symptoms had improved, “but because the parents gave up, the child finally died” — the death followed the resolution of shock on day 7 and the withdrawal of treatment on day 8, and cannot be read as the course of treated disease. The time and cause of death are not recorded.

dose.zh-CN: 头孢曲松静脉滴注，按体重计算（本例体重未记录）。
dose.en: IV ceftriaxone, weight-based (his weight is not recorded).

harm.zh-CN: 药敏显示这株紫色色杆菌对头孢曲松耐药：此时用头孢曲松，等于让耐药的菌血症和多发脓肿得不到治疗。
harm.en: The susceptibility report shows this Chromobacterium violaceum is resistant to ceftriaxone: giving it now leaves a resistant bacteraemia and multiple abscesses untreated.

response.zh-CN: 已开始头孢曲松。注意：他在外院用三代头孢（头孢哌酮）已无效；原报告讨论指出，紫色色杆菌常对青霉素和窄谱头孢菌素多重耐药，对三代头孢的敏感性不确定。
response.en: Ceftriaxone started. Note: he had already failed a third-generation cephalosporin (cefoperazone) elsewhere, and the report's discussion notes that Chromobacterium violaceum is often resistant to penicillins and narrow-spectrum cephalosporins, with uncertain susceptibility to third-generation agents.

name.zh-CN: 请外科急会诊：脓肿切开引流
name.en: Urgent surgical referral: incision and drainage of the abscess

dose.zh-CN: 外科评估后在手术室切开引流；脓液送革兰染色和培养，组织送病理。
dose.en: Surgical assessment, then incision and drainage in theatre; pus for Gram stain and culture, tissue for histology.

response.zh-CN: 外科同意尽快切开引流。原报告在入院后先观察包块变化，第3天行切开引流；尽早控制感染源是现行建议（SSC 2026）。
response.en: The surgeons agree to drain it promptly. In the report the lump was watched after admission and drained on hospital day 3; prompt source control is current advice (SSC 2026).

dose.zh-CN: 连续监测心率、血压、呼吸和SpO₂；同时记录意识和尿量。
dose.en: Continuous heart rate, blood pressure, respiration and SpO₂; record conscious level and urine output too.

response.zh-CN: 监护仪已连接。原报告没有记录入院时和第4天的血压、呼吸频率、体温及SpO₂数值。
response.en: Monitor attached. The report gives no blood pressure, respiratory rate, temperature or SpO₂ values for admission or day 4.

name.en: High-flow oxygen via a non-rebreather mask

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩15 L/min；复苏后下调，SSC 2026建议复苏后SpO₂目标88–92%。
dose.en: 15 L/min via a non-rebreather mask; wean after resuscitation — SSC 2026 suggests an SpO₂ target of 88–92% once resuscitated.

response.zh-CN: 已给高流量吸氧。原报告记录CPAP供氧未能改善氧合。
response.en: High-flow oxygen on. The report records that CPAP did not improve his oxygenation.

name.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液快速静脉补液

dose.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液10–20 mL/kg快速输注（体重未记录，需称重或估算）；每次后复评灌注、肝脏大小和肺部，出现液体过负荷即停止；有ICU条件时第1小时累计可达40–60 mL/kg（SSC 2026）。没有平衡液时可用0.9%氯化钠。
dose.en: Balanced crystalloid 10–20 mL/kg rapidly (weight not recorded: weigh or estimate); reassess perfusion, liver size and chest after each, stopping at signs of fluid overload; where intensive care is available, up to 40–60 mL/kg in the first hour (SSC 2026). 0.9% sodium chloride if no balanced solution is available.

response.zh-CN: 补液已开始，记得每次推注后复评。原报告记录了“扩容”，但没有写液体种类和容量。
response.en: Bolus running — reassess after each one. The report records “volume expansion” but not the fluid or volumes.

name.zh-CN: 白蛋白作为首选复苏液
name.en: IV albumin as the first resuscitation fluid

dose.zh-CN: 5%人血白蛋白按体重快速输注。

response.zh-CN: 已输注白蛋白。SSC 2026建议儿童初始复苏用晶体液而不是白蛋白（有条件推荐，中等确定性）。
response.en: Albumin given. SSC 2026 suggests crystalloids rather than albumin for a child's initial resuscitation (conditional recommendation, moderate certainty).

name.zh-CN: 血管活性药物持续泵入（肾上腺素或去甲肾上腺素）

dose.zh-CN: 肾上腺素或去甲肾上腺素持续静脉泵入，按PICU方案起始和滴定；可先经外周静脉给药，不必等中心静脉（SSC 2026）。
dose.en: Adrenaline or noradrenaline by continuous IV infusion, started and titrated per the PICU protocol; it may start through a peripheral vein rather than waiting for central access (SSC 2026).

response.zh-CN: 已开始泵入。SSC 2026没有就首选肾上腺素还是去甲肾上腺素作出推荐；原报告没有写所用的血管活性药物。
response.en: Infusion started. SSC 2026 makes no recommendation between adrenaline and noradrenaline; the report does not name the vasoactive drugs used.

dose.zh-CN: 苯二氮䓬类（如咪达唑仑或地西泮）按体重给药，经静脉、肌内或经黏膜途径，按本地惊厥处理流程。
dose.en: A benzodiazepine (e.g. midazolam or diazepam), weight-based, IV, IM or buccal/intranasal, per the local seizure pathway.

response.zh-CN: 已给止惊药。原报告没有写抽搐如何处理、持续多久；还要查血糖和电解质。
response.en: Given. The report does not record how the seizure was treated or how long it lasted; check glucose and electrolytes too.

name.zh-CN: 收住儿科病房（下达入院医嘱）
name.en: Admit to the children's ward (admission orders)

dose.zh-CN: 定时监测体温、心率、呼吸、血压和SpO₂；标记包块边缘；每日复评。
dose.en: Regular observations (temperature, heart rate, respiration, blood pressure, SpO₂); mark the edge of the swelling; review daily.

response.zh-CN: 入院医嘱已下达：定时监测，标记包块边缘，每日复评。
response.en: Admission orders written: regular observations, the edge of the swelling marked, daily review.

dose.zh-CN: 儿科重症团队接手，转运途中持续监护。
dose.en: Hand over to the paediatric intensive care team; monitored transfer.

response.zh-CN: PICU已接收。原报告在第4天出现休克后“急转入PICU”。
response.en: The PICU has taken him. In the report he was moved “urgently to the PICU” on day 4 when shock developed.

dose.zh-CN: 由PICU或麻醉医师快速顺序诱导插管，压力控制通气，参数按PICU方案。
dose.en: Rapid sequence intubation by the PICU or anaesthetic team; pressure-control ventilation with settings per the PICU protocol.

response.zh-CN: 已插管上机。原报告：CPAP不能改善氧合后改为压力控制机械通气（参数见PICU呼吸支持记录）。
response.en: Intubated and ventilated. In the report CPAP failed to improve oxygenation and pressure-control ventilation followed (settings in the PICU respiratory support record).

name.zh-CN: 输注血小板、血浆或冷沉淀

dose.zh-CN: 血小板、新鲜冰冻血浆或冷沉淀按体重输注，依出血情况、拟行的操作和复查结果决定。
dose.en: Platelets, fresh frozen plasma or cryoprecipitate by weight, guided by bleeding, planned procedures and repeat results.

response.zh-CN: 已输注。原报告先后输注血浆、血小板、凝血酶原复合物和冷沉淀，并“纠正弥散性血管内凝血”。
response.en: Given. In the report plasma, platelets, prothrombin complex concentrate and cryoprecipitate were given to “correct disseminated intravascular coagulation”.

dose.zh-CN: 静脉丙种球蛋白，剂量按适应证和体重（本例体重未记录）。
dose.en: IVIG, dose by indication and weight (his weight is not recorded).

response.zh-CN: 已输注。原报告把丙种球蛋白作为支持治疗的一部分；它不是儿童脓毒症的常规治疗，只在有明确适应证时与PICU和免疫科商定使用。输注后再测免疫球蛋白，就反映不了他自己的水平。
response.en: Given. In the report IVIG was part of supportive care; it is not routine treatment for sepsis in children and is used only for a specific indication agreed with the PICU and immunology teams. Once it has been given, immunoglobulin levels no longer reflect his own.

name.zh-CN: 血液净化（连续性肾脏替代治疗）

dose.zh-CN: 由PICU决定指征和模式（如液体过负荷、少尿或严重代谢紊乱）。
dose.en: Indication and mode decided by the PICU (for example fluid overload, oliguria or severe metabolic derangement).

response.zh-CN: 已开始。原报告转入PICU后即用血液净化，并在整个PICU病程中持续。
response.en: Started. In the report blood purification began soon after PICU admission and continued through the PICU course.

title.en: Get the story from his parent

hint.zh-CN: 问发热和包块怎样开始、怎样发展，外院用了什么、效果如何，以及发病前去过哪里、接触过什么。
hint.en: Ask how the fever and the lump began and progressed, what the other hospital gave and whether it helped, and where he had been and what he had been in contact with before he fell ill.

guidance.zh-CN: 家长回答病史；疼痛和走路的问题可以直接问孩子。
guidance.en: His parent gives the history; ask the boy himself about the pain and walking.

title.en: Assess him on admission and start treatment

hint.zh-CN: 检查包块和腹部，送血常规、炎症指标和影像；用抗菌药物前先留血培养，开始经验性治疗，最后下达入院医嘱。
hint.en: Examine the lump and the abdomen, send a blood count, inflammatory markers and imaging, take blood cultures before the first antibiotic, start empirical treatment, then write the admission orders.

guidance.zh-CN: 入院第1天：他仍高热、腿疼得不能走。评估和治疗都安排好、下达入院医嘱后，病程进入入院第3天。
guidance.en: Hospital day 1: he is still febrile and his leg is too sore to walk on. Once the work-up and treatment are in place and the admission orders are written, the case moves to hospital day 3.

title.en: Day 3: he is not getting better

hint.zh-CN: 重新评估他，处理脓肿，再想一想：一直不起效的方案漏掉了哪一类病原？
hint.en: Reassess him, deal with the abscess, and ask what kind of organism a regimen that is not working might be missing.

guidance.zh-CN: 入院第3天，仍高热、没精神，包块越来越大。
guidance.en: Hospital day 3: still febrile and listless, and the lump keeps growing.

hint.zh-CN: 先看灌注和意识，再看乳酸、血小板和凝血——按Phoenix标准他属于哪一类？第1小时内要做哪些事、送到哪里？
hint.en: Look at perfusion and consciousness, then lactate, platelets and clotting: where does he sit on the Phoenix criteria, what must happen within the first hour, and where should he be?

guidance.zh-CN: 入院第4天，他在病房突然恶化。作出判断、转入PICU后，病程进入PICU阶段。
guidance.en: Hospital day 4: he deteriorates suddenly on the ward. Once you have made your judgement and moved him to the PICU, the case moves to the PICU phase.

title.zh-CN: PICU：针对性治疗与免疫问题
title.en: PICU: targeted treatment and the immune question

hint.zh-CN: 读微生物报告和药敏，定下方案和疗程；再想一想：这种感染提示要查他免疫系统的哪一方面？
hint.en: Read the microbiology report and the susceptibilities, settle the regimen and its length, and ask what this infection says about which part of his immune system to test.

guidance.en: He is now in the PICU.

title.zh-CN: 核对原报告的经过与结局
title.en: Review the reported course and outcome

hint.zh-CN: 决策都完成后，会打开原报告的PICU治疗经过和结局记录；注意结局是在什么情况下发生的。
hint.en: Once the decisions are done, the report's PICU course and outcome open; note the circumstances in which the outcome happened.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院第3天：多发小脓肿伴全身感染，入院后用万古霉素仍在进展，切开引流后也没有好转；发病前约一周游过泳，外院用头孢哌酮等也无效。培养结果还没出来——抗菌方案现在怎么调整？
prompt.en: Hospital day 3: multiple small abscesses with systemic infection, progressing on vancomycin and no better after drainage; he swam about a week before falling ill and had already failed cefoperazone and another drug elsewhere. The cultures are not back — how do you change the antimicrobials now?

need.zh-CN: 先在第3天重新评估他，读切开引流记录和病理，并确认外院用药和发病前的接触史。
need.en: Reassess him on day 3, read the drainage and pathology record, and check the earlier antibiotics and what he was exposed to before he fell ill.

text.zh-CN: 现在就扩大覆盖：加用碳青霉烯类（如美罗培南）覆盖革兰阴性菌和水、土环境菌（如紫色色杆菌、气单胞菌，流行区的类鼻疽伯克霍尔德菌），培养回报前保留抗MRSA；不耽误时先复查血培养、送脓液培养，继续控制感染源。
text.en: Broaden now: add a carbapenem such as meropenem for Gram-negative and water- or soil-borne bacteria (Chromobacterium violaceum, Aeromonas; Burkholderia pseudomallei where endemic), keeping MRSA cover until the cultures return; re-culture blood and pus first if that causes no delay; continue source control.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。抗革兰阳性菌方案失败、多发脓肿进展、发病前有水体接触，都提示要覆盖革兰阴性菌和环境菌。原报告讨论也说，单一抗革兰阳性菌效果不佳时要考虑紫色色杆菌，儿科经验用药以碳青霉烯类为主。SSC 2026要求经验治疗覆盖所有可能的病原，并在不明显延误时先留培养。
feedback.en: Right. Failure of anti-Gram-positive therapy, progressing multiple abscesses and recent water exposure all call for Gram-negative and environmental cover. The report's own discussion says to consider C. violaceum when a single anti-Gram-positive agent fails, with carbapenems the main empirical choice in children. SSC 2026 asks for empirical therapy that covers all likely pathogens, with cultures first when that causes no meaningful delay.

text.zh-CN: 继续单用万古霉素：CT示皮下软组织感染伴多发小脓肿，儿童这类感染最常见的病原是金黄色葡萄球菌（包括耐甲氧西林菌株），脓肿又刚切开引流——引流和万古霉素都需要几天才能见效，暂不换药，先观察体温曲线和局部情况。
text.en: Continue vancomycin alone: the CT showed a subcutaneous soft-tissue infection with small abscesses, which in a child is most often Staphylococcus aureus, MRSA included, and the abscess has only just been drained — drainage and vancomycin both need a few days to work, so change nothing yet and watch the fever curve and the groin.

feedback.zh-CN: 这是原报告的做法：引流后继续万古霉素，第4天进展为脓毒性休克。金黄色葡萄球菌固然是儿童皮肤脓肿最常见的病原，但引流不能替代有效的抗菌药物；万古霉素对革兰阴性菌无效，而他的接触史和治疗失败都指向革兰阴性菌的可能。
feedback.en: This is what the report's team did: vancomycin continued after drainage and he developed septic shock on day 4. Staphylococcus aureus is the commonest cause of a child's skin abscess, but drainage does not replace effective antimicrobials; vancomycin has no Gram-negative activity, and his exposure and treatment failure both point to a Gram-negative possibility.

text.zh-CN: 改用头孢曲松覆盖革兰阴性菌：发病前一周游泳，提示水源性革兰阴性菌，三代头孢通常能够覆盖，每日1次给药也方便；脓肿已经切开引流，不再需要万古霉素。
text.en: Switch to ceftriaxone for Gram-negative cover: the swim a week before he fell ill suggests a water-borne Gram-negative organism, which a once-daily third-generation cephalosporin usually covers, and the drained abscess no longer needs vancomycin.

feedback.zh-CN: 他在外院用三代头孢（头孢哌酮）已无效；原报告讨论指出紫色色杆菌常对青霉素和窄谱头孢菌素多重耐药、对三代头孢的敏感性不确定——本例菌株后来正是对头孢曲松和头孢他啶耐药。停掉抗MRSA的药物也不安全。
feedback.en: He had already failed a third-generation cephalosporin (cefoperazone) elsewhere; the discussion notes that C. violaceum is often resistant to penicillins and narrow-spectrum cephalosporins, with uncertain susceptibility to third-generation agents — and this isolate later proved resistant to ceftriaxone and ceftazidime. Dropping MRSA cover is not safe either.

text.zh-CN: 维持万古霉素，等血和脓液的培养及药敏回来再针对性换药：已经有两套方案无效，再凭经验猜一次，只会增加耐药和不良反应，仍然不知道在治什么菌。
text.en: Keep vancomycin and wait for the blood and pus culture and susceptibility results before changing: two regimens have already failed, and another empirical guess adds resistance and side effects without telling you which organism you are treating.

feedback.zh-CN: 等培养会耽误时间：作者也指出培养出结果需要时间，所以临床上治疗失败时就要及时调整经验治疗。SSC 2026要求经验治疗覆盖所有可能的病原，培养回报后再降阶梯。
feedback.en: Waiting costs time: the authors point out that cultures take time to grow, which is why empirical treatment must change as soon as it is failing clinically. SSC 2026 asks for empirical cover of all likely pathogens, narrowing once the cultures return.

text.zh-CN: 在万古霉素基础上加用克林霉素：产毒素的葡萄球菌或链球菌感染可以解释寒战、40.5 ℃高热和不断增大的脓肿，克林霉素能抑制毒素产生，万古霉素继续覆盖MRSA，两药联用覆盖最可能的病原。
text.en: Add clindamycin to vancomycin: a toxin-producing staphylococcal or streptococcal infection would explain the rigors, the fever of 40.5 °C and the growing abscess, and clindamycin suppresses toxin production while vancomycin keeps MRSA covered, so together they cover the likeliest organisms.

feedback.zh-CN: 两种药都只针对革兰阳性菌，革兰阴性菌和环境菌仍然没有覆盖——这正是他的感染一直进展的原因。
feedback.en: Both drugs target Gram-positive bacteria only; Gram-negative and environmental organisms are still uncovered — the very gap that let his infection progress.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院第4天：烦躁、呼吸困难、四肢厥冷、足背动脉搏动摸不到、心率220次/分，随后抽搐、意识丧失。复查：乳酸887 mg/L（约9.8 mmol/L）、血小板9×10⁹/L、INR 1.77。怎样判断？第1小时做什么？
prompt.en: Hospital day 4: agitated, breathless, cold limbs, impalpable dorsalis pedis pulses, heart rate 220/min, then a seizure with loss of consciousness. Repeat bloods: lactate 887 mg/L (≈ 9.8 mmol/L), platelets 9×10⁹/L, INR 1.77. What is this, and what happens in the first hour?

need.zh-CN: 先在床旁评估他的循环和意识，再读第4天的血生化（含乳酸）、血常规和凝血结果。
need.en: Assess his circulation and consciousness at the bedside, then read the day-4 chemistry (with lactate), blood count and clotting results.

text.zh-CN: 脓毒性休克（Phoenix：乳酸计1个心血管分，血小板、INR各1分），无需等低血压：1小时内静脉给广谱抗菌药（不耽误就先留血培养），高流量吸氧，平衡晶体液10–20 mL/kg推注、逐次复评，尽早用肾上腺素或去甲肾上腺素，止惊，立即转PICU。
text.en: Septic shock (Phoenix: lactate 1 cardiovascular point, platelets and INR 1 each), no hypotension needed: IV broad-spectrum antimicrobials within 1 hour (cultures first if no delay), high-flow oxygen, 10–20 mL/kg balanced crystalloid boluses reassessed after each, early adrenaline or noradrenaline, stop the seizure, PICU now.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。Phoenix 2024：疑似感染且Phoenix评分≥2分为脓毒症，其中至少1个心血管分即为脓毒性休克；他的乳酸约9.8 mmol/L（1分）加上凝血2分，已经达标。SSC 2026：疑似脓毒性休克在识别后1小时内给抗菌药物，初始评估时测乳酸，有ICU条件时首小时可分次给到40–60 mL/kg，用晶体液而不用白蛋白，出现液体过负荷即停；肾上腺素或去甲肾上腺素可经外周静脉开始，同时备好气道支持。
feedback.en: Right. Phoenix 2024: suspected infection with a Phoenix score ≥ 2 is sepsis, and at least one cardiovascular point makes it septic shock; his lactate of ≈ 9.8 mmol/L (1 point) plus clotting (2 points) meets it. SSC 2026: antimicrobials within 1 hour of recognising suspected septic shock, lactate at the first assessment, up to 40–60 mL/kg in boluses over the first hour where intensive care is available, and crystalloid rather than albumin, stopping at signs of fluid overload; adrenaline or noradrenaline may start through a peripheral vein, with airway support ready.

text.zh-CN: 还不是休克：血压还没有记录，抽搐本身也会让乳酸一过性升高，儿童在测到低血压之前不能诊断休克，所以先测血压、接上心电监护；同时用一种苯二氮䓬类药物止惊，给高流量吸氧，复查血常规和凝血功能，等血压证实确实偏低以后，再联系PICU，并升级抗菌药物和补液。
text.en: Not shock yet: no blood pressure is recorded and a seizure alone can raise the lactate for a while, so shock in a child needs documented hypotension first; measure it and attach the monitor, stop the seizure with a benzodiazepine, give high-flow oxygen, repeat the blood count and clotting, and call the PICU and escalate antimicrobials and fluids only once the pressure proves low.

feedback.zh-CN: Phoenix标准的心血管分可以来自乳酸或血管活性药物需求，不要求先有低血压；儿童的低血压往往是晚期表现。抽搐确实会让乳酸升高，但解释不了四肢厥冷、脉搏摸不到和220次/分的心率——等血压只会延误抢救。
feedback.en: Phoenix cardiovascular points can come from lactate or the need for vasoactive drugs; hypotension is not required, and in children it is often a late sign. A seizure can raise the lactate, but it does not explain cold limbs, impalpable pulses and a heart rate of 220/min — waiting for a pressure only delays resuscitation.

text.zh-CN: 高热惊厥合并局部脓肿：连续几天发热最高达40.5 ℃，心率220次/分和四肢厥冷都来自发热和抽搐，两者都停下来后就会缓解；所以给退热药和一种苯二氮䓬类药物并查血糖，让他留在病房吸氧、监测生命体征，等培养结果回来再调整抗菌药物。
text.en: A febrile seizure with a local abscess: after days of fever up to 40.5 °C, the heart rate of 220/min and the cold limbs come from the fever and the fit and will settle once both stop, so give an antipyretic and a benzodiazepine and check his glucose, keep him on the ward with oxygen and observations, and adjust the antimicrobials when the cultures return.

feedback.zh-CN: 8岁已超出热性惊厥的常见年龄；发热也解释不了足背动脉摸不到和220次/分的心率——他同时有休克征象和多器官受累（乳酸、血小板、凝血、转氨酶）。这是脓毒性休克，需要PICU。
feedback.en: At 8 he is beyond the usual age for febrile seizures, and fever does not explain impalpable foot pulses with a heart rate of 220/min: he has signs of shock and multi-organ involvement (lactate, platelets, clotting, transaminases). This is septic shock and needs the PICU.

text.zh-CN: 脓毒性休克：四肢厥冷、足背动脉摸不到、心率220次/分，扩容优先于一切——先把60 mL/kg生理盐水尽快推完，能开几条通路就开几条，再复评，然后开始抗菌药物、转PICU。
text.en: Septic shock: with cold limbs, impalpable foot pulses and a heart rate of 220/min, volume comes before everything else — push 60 mL/kg of 0.9% saline as fast as possible through every line you can get, then reassess, start the antimicrobials and move him to the PICU.

feedback.zh-CN: SSC 2026建议有ICU条件时每次10–20 mL/kg、每次后复评，按心输出量指标滴定，出现液体过负荷就停（首小时累计可达40–60 mL/kg），并首选平衡晶体液；不复评就一次推完60 mL/kg，有液体过负荷的风险，也会推迟抗菌药物和血管活性药物。
feedback.en: SSC 2026 advises 10–20 mL/kg per bolus with reassessment after each where intensive care is available, titrated to cardiac-output markers and stopped at fluid overload (up to 40–60 mL/kg in the first hour), preferring a balanced crystalloid; 60 mL/kg pushed without reassessment risks fluid overload and delays antimicrobials and vasoactive drugs.

text.zh-CN: 脓毒性休克伴肝损伤（AST 990 U/L），很可能有毛细血管渗漏：首选白蛋白复苏——胶体能留在血管内，晶体液会渗到组织间隙——晶体液留到后面用；随后用抗菌药物、转PICU。
text.en: Septic shock with liver injury (AST 990 U/L) and probable capillary leak: use albumin as the first resuscitation fluid, since a colloid stays in the circulation where crystalloid leaks away, and keep crystalloid for later; then the antimicrobials and the PICU.

feedback.zh-CN: SSC 2026建议儿童初始复苏用晶体液而不是白蛋白（有条件推荐，中等确定性）；毛细血管渗漏时白蛋白同样会漏出血管。抗菌药物也不应等补液输完再给。
feedback.en: SSC 2026 suggests crystalloids rather than albumin for a child's initial resuscitation (conditional recommendation, moderate certainty); in capillary leak albumin leaves the circulation too. Nor should the antimicrobials wait until a fluid has run in.

prompt.zh-CN: PICU：血和两份腹股沟穿刺液都培养出紫色色杆菌，药敏已出；他有过抽搐和意识丧失。接下来的抗菌治疗是？
prompt.en: PICU: blood and both groin aspirates grew Chromobacterium violaceum and the susceptibilities are back; he has had a seizure with loss of consciousness. What is the antimicrobial plan now?

need.zh-CN: 先读微生物报告和药敏。
need.en: Read the microbiology report and the susceptibilities first.

text.zh-CN: 用敏感的美罗培南（有神经系统表现，用中枢剂量）；长疗程（多发小脓肿时作者建议6周），影像复查深部脓肿；稳定后按药敏调整（如环丙沙星或复方磺胺甲噁唑），观察有无复发。
text.en: Meropenem (susceptible) at CNS doses for his neurological signs; a long course — 6 weeks for multiple small abscesses, as the authors advise — with imaging for deep abscesses; once stable, adjust by susceptibility (e.g. ciprofloxacin or co-trimoxazole) and watch for recurrence.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。原报告即按药敏、并考虑中枢神经系统症状改用美罗培南；作者因多发小脓肿建议疗程6周。Yang和Li（2011）的综述强调早诊断、合适的抗菌药物和足够的疗程。SSC 2026：病原和药敏明确后应调整（降阶梯）经验治疗。
feedback.en: Right. The report's team switched to meropenem on the susceptibilities and because of his CNS signs; the authors advise 6 weeks because of the multiple small abscesses. Yang and Li's review (2011) stresses early diagnosis, appropriate antimicrobials and an adequate course. SSC 2026: once the pathogen and susceptibilities are known, adjust (narrow) the empirical therapy.

text.zh-CN: 改用大剂量头孢他啶：这种抗假单胞菌的三代头孢菌素是治疗类鼻疽等水、土环境革兰阴性菌感染的常用药，用它可以把碳青霉烯类留给耐药菌；疗程同样要长，并影像复查有无深部脓肿。
text.en: Switch to high-dose ceftazidime, the antipseudomonal third-generation cephalosporin used for melioidosis and other water- and soil-borne Gram-negative infections, keeping the carbapenems in reserve for resistant organisms; the same long course, with imaging for any deep abscesses.

feedback.zh-CN: 药敏报告这株菌对头孢他啶和头孢曲松都耐药。节约碳青霉烯类固然重要，但只能在细菌敏感的药物中选择；类鼻疽的方案也不能照搬到紫色色杆菌。
feedback.en: The isolate is reported resistant to both ceftazidime and ceftriaxone. Sparing carbapenems matters, but only among agents the organism is susceptible to, and a melioidosis regimen does not transfer to Chromobacterium violaceum.

text.zh-CN: 改用哌拉西林/他唑巴坦：广谱β-内酰胺类，覆盖革兰阴性菌和厌氧菌，又能节省碳青霉烯类；药敏只是中介而不是耐药，用大剂量、延长输注应该可以克服，疗程同样要长。
text.en: Switch to piperacillin/tazobactam, a broad-spectrum β-lactam with Gram-negative and anaerobic cover that spares the carbapenems: the isolate is intermediate rather than resistant, so a high dose by extended infusion should overcome it, over the same long course.

feedback.zh-CN: 药敏为中介（哌拉西林单药耐药），而且这种细菌没有专门的折点，不能指望加大剂量来克服；对伴菌血症、多发脓肿和神经系统表现的患儿，不应选用中介的药物。
feedback.en: It is reported intermediate (piperacillin alone is resistant), and with no dedicated breakpoints for this organism a higher dose cannot be relied on to overcome it; an intermediate agent is not a choice for a child with bacteraemia, multiple abscesses and neurological signs.

text.zh-CN: 美罗培南（中枢剂量）用到休克纠正后再用7天即停：腹股沟脓肿已经引流，细菌对它敏感，短疗程可以减少耐药、导管并发症、药物毒性和住院时间。
text.en: Meropenem at CNS doses until the shock has resolved, then 7 more days and stop: the groin abscess has been drained and the isolate is susceptible, and a shorter course limits resistance, line complications, drug toxicity and his time in hospital.

feedback.zh-CN: 多发小脓肿（包括可能的深部脓肿）需要长疗程，作者建议抗菌6周；腹股沟一处引流清除不了其他脓肿，休克纠正也不等于脓肿已经清除。
feedback.en: Multiple small abscesses (and possible deep ones) need a long course — the authors advise 6 weeks; draining one groin collection does not clear the others, and resolution of shock does not mean the abscesses have cleared.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的免疫球蛋白和T细胞亚群已经查过，作者认为体液免疫和细胞免疫都正常。对这名患儿，免疫方面还需要做什么？
prompt.en: His immunoglobulins and T-cell subsets have been measured, and the authors consider humoral and cellular immunity normal. What else does his immune assessment need?

need.zh-CN: 先读微生物报告，并调阅入院后的免疫功能检查。
need.en: Read the microbiology report and the immune tests from admission first.

text.zh-CN: 查吞噬细胞氧化杀菌功能（DHR，无条件时NBT）筛查慢性肉芽肿病，并测G6PD——抗体和T细胞反映不了中性粒细胞杀菌；请免疫科随访，追问他和家中男孩的反复感染史。
text.en: Screen for chronic granulomatous disease with a phagocyte oxidative-burst test (DHR, or NBT if unavailable) and measure G6PD — antibodies and T cells do not test neutrophil killing; refer to immunology and ask about repeated infections in him and in boys in the family.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。原报告讨论引用的文献指出，紫色色杆菌脓毒症常继发于严重G6PD缺乏、中性粒细胞功能障碍或慢性肉芽肿病——这些患者的吞噬细胞产生不了杀菌所需的氧代谢产物。原报告只查了体液和T细胞免疫，没有吞噬细胞功能和G6PD的结果，所以“免疫正常”的结论并不完整。
feedback.en: Right. The literature cited in the report's discussion links C. violaceum sepsis to severe G6PD deficiency, neutrophil dysfunction and chronic granulomatous disease, in which phagocytes cannot make the oxygen metabolites needed to kill the organism. The report tested only antibodies and T cells and gives no phagocyte-function or G6PD result, so its “normal immunity” conclusion is incomplete.

text.zh-CN: 免疫评估已经完整：IgG、IgA、IgM和T细胞亚群都报告正常，作者也认为体液和细胞免疫正常；发病前一周游泳时的水体暴露足以解释这次感染，不需要再用免疫缺陷来解释，不必再查，可以让家长放心。
text.en: The immune work-up is complete: IgG, IgA, IgM and T-cell subsets were reported normal, as the authors note, and exposure in the water he swam in a week before he fell ill explains the infection without an immune defect, so no further tests are needed and the family can be reassured.

feedback.zh-CN: 这是原报告的结论，但这些检查只评估抗体和T细胞，评估不了中性粒细胞的氧化杀菌功能——而与紫色色杆菌侵袭性感染相关的正是这类缺陷。接触水、土中的这种细菌很常见，接触后发生严重侵袭性感染，才提示要查宿主缺陷。
feedback.en: This is the report's conclusion, but these tests assess antibodies and T cells, not neutrophil oxidative killing — the kind of defect linked to invasive C. violaceum infection. Exposure to the organism in water and soil is common; a severe invasive infection after it is what raises the question of a host defect.

text.zh-CN: 只查HIV和血糖，这是筛查获得性免疫抑制的常规项目：免疫球蛋白和T细胞亚群都报告正常，罕见的先天缺陷可能性不大，剩下要排除的是获得性原因。
text.en: Test only for HIV and diabetes, the usual screen for an acquired cause of immunosuppression: with immunoglobulins and T-cell subsets reported normal, a rare congenital defect is unlikely and an acquired cause is what is left to exclude.

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告讨论指出，紫色色杆菌感染与HIV感染、糖尿病、化疗或长期使用免疫抑制剂和激素没有明确关系；抗体和T细胞正常也不能说明吞噬细胞没有缺陷。要查的是吞噬细胞功能和G6PD。
feedback.en: The report's discussion notes no clear link between C. violaceum infection and HIV, diabetes, chemotherapy or long-term immunosuppressants or steroids, and normal antibodies and T cells do not make a phagocyte defect unlikely; what needs testing is phagocyte function and G6PD.

text.zh-CN: 如果用过丙种球蛋白，输完几周后复查免疫球蛋白，确认病程中他的抗体水平维持得住，正常就可以放心——抗体缺陷是最常见的原发性免疫缺陷。
text.en: If he has had IVIG, re-check his immunoglobulins a few weeks afterwards to be sure his antibody levels hold up through the illness, and be reassured if they are normal — antibody deficiency is the commonest primary immunodeficiency.

feedback.zh-CN: 输注丙种球蛋白后，IgG水平反映的是输入的抗体而不是他自己的。抗体缺陷固然是最常见的原发性免疫缺陷，但免疫球蛋白查不出紫色色杆菌侵袭性感染所提示的吞噬细胞缺陷。
feedback.en: After IVIG the IgG level reflects the infused antibody, not his own. Antibody deficiency is the commonest primary immunodeficiency, but immunoglobulins cannot detect the phagocyte defect that invasive C. violaceum infection points to.

text.zh-CN: 问清发热和包块的经过、外院用药及发病前的水体接触
text.en: Elicited the course of the fever and lump, the earlier antibiotics and the water exposure before onset

text.zh-CN: 询问以前有无反复或严重感染（筛查宿主免疫缺陷）
text.en: Asked about previous repeated or serious infections (screening for an immune defect)

text.zh-CN: 入院时检查一般情况、包块和肝脾
text.en: Examined his general state, the lump, and the liver and spleen on admission

text.zh-CN: 入院时查血常规、炎症指标和影像，并留血培养
text.en: Sent the admission blood count, inflammatory markers and imaging, and took blood cultures

text.zh-CN: 第3天培养回报前及时扩大经验性覆盖（第一次即答对）
text.en: Broadened empirical cover on day 3, before the cultures (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 请外科切开引流（感染源控制）
text.en: Arranged incision and drainage (source control)

text.zh-CN: 按Phoenix标准识别脓毒性休克并说出第1小时的处置（第一次即答对）
text.en: Recognised septic shock by the Phoenix criteria and stated the first-hour priorities (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 给予广谱抗菌药物、晶体液复苏和高流量吸氧，并转入PICU
text.en: Gave broad-spectrum antimicrobials, crystalloid resuscitation and high-flow oxygen, and moved him to the PICU

text.zh-CN: 按药敏选择目标治疗并定长疗程（第一次即答对）
text.en: Chose definitive therapy by the susceptibilities with a long course (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 提出吞噬细胞功能（DHR/NBT）和G6PD检测（第一次即答对）
text.en: Asked for phagocyte-function (DHR/NBT) and G6PD testing (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 没有使用头孢曲松（本株耐药）
text.en: Did not use ceftriaxone (the isolate was resistant)

text.zh-CN: 与家长沟通：用通俗的话解释病情加重、转PICU和治疗方向，回应担心，核实理解
text.en: Talked with the parent: explained in plain words that he was getting worse, why the PICU, and the plan; responded to worries; checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现：不堆砌术语地说明“感染扩散到全身、出现休克，需要重症监护和更强的抗生素”；如实说明病情危重、结局不确定；询问并回应家长的担心（为什么之前的药没用、要不要开刀）；用回授法确认理解；不对未知的事情（费用、结局）作保证。原报告没有记录与家长沟通的细节，也没有记录放弃治疗前的讨论。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: explains without jargon that “the infection has spread through his body and caused shock, so he needs intensive care and stronger antibiotics”; is honest that he is critically ill and the outcome is uncertain; asks about and answers the parent's worries (why the earlier medicines failed, whether he needs an operation); checks understanding by teach-back; makes no promises about unknowns (costs, outcome). The report records no details of conversations with the family, nor of any discussion before treatment was withdrawn.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学，按时间推进：入院第1天、第3天、第4天、PICU，每个阶段都先用当时已有的证据作判断。用苏格拉底式提问引导学员：抗革兰阳性菌方案失败时漏掉了哪一类病原；淡水或泥土接触有什么意义；Phoenix标准的心血管分可以来自哪里；第1小时的优先事项；为什么免疫球蛋白和T细胞正常不等于免疫功能正常。不提前透露培养结果、原报告后来的治疗和结局。原报告没有记录血压、呼吸、SpO₂、体重和药物剂量，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case that moves through time — hospital day 1, day 3, day 4, the PICU — and each phase is judged on the evidence available then. Use Socratic questions: which kind of organism a failing anti-Gram-positive regimen misses; what freshwater or soil exposure means; where Phoenix cardiovascular points can come from; the first-hour priorities; why normal immunoglobulins and T cells are not normal immunity. Do not reveal the culture result, the report's later treatment or the outcome early. The report records no blood pressure, respiratory rate, SpO₂, weight or drug doses — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。孩子由急诊转来，家长陪同。可以协助建立静脉通路、采血、送培养、连接监护、吸氧、补液和转运；会提醒学员：入院时没有测量的数值（血压、呼吸、SpO₂、体重）病历里没有，不能当作正常。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. He came up from the emergency department with his parent. Can help with IV access, blood samples and cultures, the monitor, oxygen, fluids and transfers, and reminds the learner that values never measured on admission (blood pressure, respiratory rate, SpO₂, weight) are not in the notes and cannot be taken as normal.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：紫色色杆菌脓毒症与脓毒性休克
title.en: Debrief: Chromobacterium violaceum sepsis and septic shock

conclusion.zh-CN: 8岁男孩，发病前约一周游泳，发热伴右腹股沟多发小脓肿，外院头孢哌酮等及入院后万古霉素均无效，第4天进展为脓毒性休克（Phoenix：乳酸约9.8 mmol/L、血小板9×10⁹/L、INR 1.77），伴抽搐、弥散性血管内凝血和多器官受累；血和腹股沟穿刺液均培养出紫色色杆菌。改用美罗培南并给予器官支持后，第7天休克纠正；第8天家长因经济原因放弃治疗，随访获悉患儿死亡。
conclusion.en: An 8-year-old boy who swam about a week before falling ill developed fever with multiple small abscesses in the right groin that failed cefoperazone and another drug elsewhere and then vancomycin; on day 4 he progressed to septic shock (Phoenix: lactate ≈ 9.8 mmol/L, platelets 9×10⁹/L, INR 1.77) with a seizure, disseminated intravascular coagulation and multi-organ involvement. Blood and groin aspirates grew Chromobacterium violaceum. On meropenem and organ support the shock had resolved by day 7; on day 8 his parents withdrew treatment for financial reasons, and follow-up learned that he had died.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗革兰阳性菌治疗中多发脓肿仍在进展、伴全身感染、发病前有水体接触：应及时扩大到革兰阴性菌和环境菌，而不是等培养。
keyReasoning.en: Multiple abscesses progressing with systemic infection on anti-Gram-positive therapy, after water exposure: broaden to Gram-negative and environmental organisms promptly rather than waiting for the cultures.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 第4天已是脓毒性休克：Phoenix标准不要求低血压，乳酸≥5 mmol/L就得心血管分；第1小时的抗菌药物、液体复苏、血管活性药物和PICU都是时间关键的。
keyReasoning.en: Day 4 was septic shock: Phoenix does not require hypotension — a lactate ≥ 5 mmol/L earns a cardiovascular point — and first-hour antimicrobials, fluids, vasoactive drugs and the PICU are all time-critical.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血和病灶培养一致，确立了侵袭性紫色色杆菌感染；目标治疗按药敏，作者因多发小脓肿建议疗程6周。
keyReasoning.en: Concordant blood and lesion cultures established invasive C. violaceum infection; definitive therapy follows the susceptibilities, and the authors advise 6 weeks because of the multiple small abscesses.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 免疫球蛋白和T细胞亚群正常不能排除吞噬细胞缺陷；这种感染提示要查DHR/NBT和G6PD。
keyReasoning.en: Normal immunoglobulins and T-cell subsets do not exclude a phagocyte defect; this infection calls for DHR/NBT and G6PD testing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 入院时内毒素<5 pg/mL，并没有排除革兰阴性菌感染——培养最终检出的是革兰阴性杆菌。
keyReasoning.en: An admission endotoxin below 5 pg/mL did not exclude Gram-negative infection — the cultures grew a Gram-negative bacillus.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 结局要按原文解读：死亡发生在第7天休克纠正、第8天家长因经济原因放弃治疗之后，原报告称用药后感染已有所控制。
keyReasoning.en: Read the outcome as reported: the death followed the resolution of shock on day 7 and the parents' withdrawal of treatment for financial reasons on day 8, and the report says the infection had begun to respond.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能据此证明某种抗菌药物或支持治疗的独立疗效，也不能把本株药敏推广到所有菌株。原报告的处置作为历史事实记录；决策和评分依据现行指南设计，是教学设计。原报告没有血压、呼吸、SpO₂、体重和药物剂量，Phoenix评分只能按已有数据计算。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report: it cannot show the independent effect of any antimicrobial or support measure, and this isolate's susceptibilities cannot be generalised. The report's management is recorded as historical fact; the decisions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The report gives no blood pressure, respiratory rate, SpO₂, weight or drug doses, so the Phoenix score can be calculated only from the data available.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗革兰阳性菌治疗中多发脓肿仍在进展、伴全身感染、发病前有淡水或泥土接触时，要想到紫色色杆菌和其他环境革兰阴性菌（流行区还有类鼻疽），及时扩大覆盖，不要等培养。原报告作者的结论正是如此：单一抗革兰阳性菌效果不佳时要考虑该菌，儿科经验用药以碳青霉烯类为主；Yang和Li（2011）及Alisjahbana等（2021）的综述也强调要提高警惕、及早诊断。历史做法：本例入院后单用万古霉素，直到第4天培养回报才换药（病程第9天，作者称“用药稍迟”）。
teachingPoints.en: When multiple abscesses progress with systemic infection on anti-Gram-positive therapy after freshwater or soil exposure, think of Chromobacterium violaceum and other environmental Gram-negative organisms (and melioidosis where endemic) and broaden early rather than waiting for cultures. That is the report's own conclusion — consider this organism when a single anti-Gram-positive agent fails, with carbapenems the main empirical choice in children — and the reviews by Yang and Li (2011) and Alisjahbana et al. (2021) stress suspicion and early diagnosis. Historical practice: here vancomycin was used alone until the cultures came back on day 4 (illness day 9, “a little late” in the authors' words).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: Phoenix 2024（SCCM儿童脓毒症定义工作组）：疑似感染且Phoenix评分≥2分为脓毒症；在此基础上至少1个心血管分为脓毒性休克。心血管分可来自血管活性药物、乳酸（5–10.9 mmol/L得1分，≥11得2分）或按年龄的平均动脉压，不要求低血压。本例第4天：乳酸887 mg/L≈9.8 mmol/L（1分），血小板9×10⁹/L和INR 1.77（凝血共2分），即达到脓毒性休克；格拉斯哥评分和血压未记录，只能按已有数据计分。原报告用的是当时的“脓毒症”概念（入院即诊断）。
teachingPoints.en: Phoenix 2024 (SCCM Pediatric Sepsis Definition Task Force): suspected infection with a Phoenix score ≥ 2 is sepsis, and at least one cardiovascular point on top makes it septic shock. Cardiovascular points come from vasoactive drugs, lactate (5–10.9 mmol/L 1 point, ≥ 11 2 points) or mean arterial pressure for age — hypotension is not required. Here on day 4: lactate 887 mg/L ≈ 9.8 mmol/L (1 point) and platelets 9×10⁹/L with an INR of 1.77 (2 coagulation points) make septic shock; his Glasgow score and blood pressure are not recorded, so only the available data can be scored. The report used the older concept of “sepsis” (diagnosed on admission).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: SSC 2026儿童指南的第1小时：疑似脓毒性休克在识别后1小时内给予抗菌药物（无休克的可能脓毒症在快速评估后3小时内）；不明显延误时先留血培养；初始评估时测乳酸；有ICU条件时每次10–20 mL/kg、首小时累计可达40–60 mL/kg，每次后复评、出现液体过负荷即停；用晶体液而非白蛋白，首选平衡液；血管活性药物可经外周静脉起始；首选肾上腺素还是去甲肾上腺素没有推荐；尽早控制感染源。原报告没有记录液体容量、血管活性药物和用药时间，无法逐项核对。
teachingPoints.en: The first hour in the SSC 2026 children's guidelines: antimicrobials within 1 hour of recognising suspected septic shock (within 3 hours, after rapid assessment, for probable sepsis without shock); blood cultures first when that causes no meaningful delay; lactate at the first assessment; where intensive care is available, 10–20 mL/kg boluses up to 40–60 mL/kg in the first hour, reassessing after each and stopping at fluid overload; crystalloid rather than albumin, preferably balanced; vasoactive drugs may start through a peripheral vein; no recommendation between adrenaline and noradrenaline; source control as early as possible. The report records no fluid volumes, vasoactive drugs or drug timings, so these cannot be checked against it.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 目标治疗按药敏：本株对碳青霉烯类、氟喹诺酮类、氨基糖苷类、头孢吡肟、氨曲南和复方磺胺甲噁唑敏感，对头孢曲松、头孢他啶和哌拉西林耐药；该菌没有专门的判读标准，原文也未给MIC，不能把本株药敏推广到所有菌株。作者因多发小脓肿建议抗菌6周；SSC 2026建议病原明确后降阶梯。
teachingPoints.en: Definitive therapy follows the susceptibilities: this isolate was susceptible to carbapenems, fluoroquinolones, aminoglycosides, cefepime, aztreonam and co-trimoxazole and resistant to ceftriaxone, ceftazidime and piperacillin. There are no dedicated breakpoints for the organism and the report gives no MICs, so this isolate's pattern cannot be generalised. The authors advise 6 weeks of antimicrobials because of the multiple small abscesses; SSC 2026 advises narrowing once the pathogen is known.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 宿主评估：紫色色杆菌侵袭性感染与慢性肉芽肿病、中性粒细胞功能障碍和严重G6PD缺乏有关（原报告讨论及其引文；Sirinavin等2005年的儿童病例综述）。筛查要查吞噬细胞的氧化杀菌功能（DHR流式，或NBT），并测G6PD（AAAAI 2015原发性免疫缺陷实践参数）；免疫球蛋白和T细胞亚群正常不能排除这些缺陷。本例只查了体液和T细胞免疫，原报告却据此称“免疫正常”。
teachingPoints.en: Host work-up: invasive C. violaceum infection is linked to chronic granulomatous disease, neutrophil dysfunction and severe G6PD deficiency (the report's discussion and its sources; Sirinavin et al.'s 2005 paediatric review). Screening tests phagocyte oxidative killing (DHR flow cytometry, or NBT) and G6PD (AAAAI 2015 practice parameter on primary immunodeficiency); normal immunoglobulins and T-cell subsets do not exclude these defects. Here only antibodies and T cells were tested, yet the report calls his immunity normal.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 解读结局要按原文：休克在第7天纠正，家长在第8天因经济原因放弃治疗，随访获悉患儿死亡；作者称用药后感染已有所控制。把它当成“治疗无效的死亡”是误读。讨论中25例国内病例的转归（死亡15例、治愈4例、未注明6例）来自病例报告汇总，存在发表偏倚。
teachingPoints.en: Read the outcome as reported: the shock had resolved by day 7, his parents withdrew treatment for financial reasons on day 8, and follow-up learned that he had died; the authors say the infection had begun to respond. Reading this as “death despite treatment” is a misreading. The outcomes of the 25 Chinese cases in the discussion (15 died, 4 recovered, 6 not stated) come from pooled case reports and carry publication bias.
